DNG Martin O'Connor Land Sales are delighted to offer for sale by Private Treaty this varied agricultural landholding at Bantrach/Banraghbaun, Ballinahown, Inverin, Co. Galway.

Held under Folios GY127219F, GY30378F and GY40955F, the sale comprises five individual parcels of land extending to a combined area of approximately 2.51 Ha (6.20 Acres), together with 1/20th undivided shares in three areas of commonage extending overall to approximately 300.86 Ha (743.45 Acres).

The lands are dispersed throughout the locality and offer an interesting combination of individual agricultural parcels and substantial commonage interests in a scenic South Connemara setting. The holding presents an excellent opportunity for adjoining or local landowners wishing to extend an existing holding, or for purchasers seeking to acquire agricultural lands and commonage interests in the area.

All of the lands and commonage interests detailed below are being offered together as one sale.

FOLIO GY127219F FILE PLAN 6D

Approximately 0.40 Ha (0.99 Acres)

A compact parcel of agricultural land extending to approximately 0.40 Ha (0.99 Acres), situated in the Bantrach/Ballinahown area and forming part of the overall holding.

FOLIO GY127219F FILE PLAN 6E

Approximately 0.54 Ha (1.33 Acres)

A separate parcel of agricultural land extending to approximately 0.54 Ha (1.33 Acres), also situated in the Bantrach/Ballinahown area and forming part of the overall holding.

FOLIO GY30378F FILE PLAN 15C

Approximately 0.84 Ha (2.07 Acres)

This parcel extends to approximately 0.84 Ha (2.07 Acres) and is laid out in a number of smaller field sections in an attractive setting bordering a lake.
Access to the lands is over commonage ground by way of a narrow lane. The lands offer potential for reclamation and improvement to provide useful grazing ground.

FOLIO GY30378F FILE PLAN 15D

Approximately 0.38 Ha (0.93 Acres)

This attractive roadside parcel extends to approximately 0.38 Ha (0.93 Acres) and is positioned on the right-hand side of the road when travelling towards the sea.
The lands comprise a level field, currently used for grazing purposes, and are enclosed by a well-built traditional dry stone wall.
Given its roadside position and level nature, the lands may offer potential for a residential site, subject to obtaining the necessary planning permission.

FOLIO GY30378F FILE PLAN 26B

Overall Commonage Area: Approximately 9.93 Ha (24.54 Acres)

Interest For Sale: 1/20th Undivided Share
File Plan 26B comprises an area of commonage extending overall to approximately 9.93 Ha (24.54 Acres).
Included in the sale is a 1/20th undivided share in this commonage, representing an equivalent area of approximately 0.50 Ha (1.23 Acres).

FOLIO GY30378F FILE PLAN 1

Banraghbaun North Commonage
Overall Commonage Area: Approximately 146.28 Ha (361.46 Acres)

Interest For Sale: 1/20th Undivided Share
Situated at Banraghbaun North, File Plan 1 comprises an extensive area of commonage extending overall to approximately 146.28 Ha (361.46 Acres).
Included in the sale is a 1/20th undivided share, representing an equivalent area of approximately 7.31 Ha (18.07 Acres).

FOLIO GY40955F FILE PLAN 12C

Approximately 0.35 Ha (0.86 Acres)
A parcel of agricultural land extending to approximately 0.35 Ha (0.86 Acres), bounded by traditional stone walls and accessed by way of a narrow roadway.

FOLIO GY30378F FILE PLAN 26

Banraghbaun South Commonage
Overall Commonage Area: Approximately 144.65 Ha (357.44 Acres)
Interest For Sale: 1/20th Undivided Share
Situated at Banraghbaun South, File Plan 26 comprises an extensive area of commonage extending overall to approximately 144.65 Ha (357.44 Acres).
Included in the sale is a 1/20th undivided share, representing an equivalent area of approximately 7.23 Ha (17.87 Acres).

Directions
From Galway take the coast road and go through Spiddal onto Inverin. At Tully (TG4) watch out for the shop (Costcutters) on the left hand side. Just past this the road goes in three directions. Take the centre road towards Rosaveal. Drive along this road and take the second left turning. Drive along this road follow the map directions. The lands are identified by DNG Martin O'Connor For Sale sings.

• All lands and commonage interests offered together as one lot
  • Approx. 2.51 Ha (6.20 Acres) of individual agricultural land parcels
  • 1/20th undivided shares in three separate commonage areas
  • Commonage areas extend overall to approx. 300.86 Ha (743.44 Acres)
  • Combined 1/20th interests represent an equivalent area of approx. 15.04 Ha (37.17 Acres)
  • Roadside 0.38 Ha (0.93 Acre) parcel with potential for a residential site, SPP
  • Lands held under Folios GY127219F, GY30378F and GY40955F
  • Attractive South Connemara setting
  • Ideal opportunity for adjoining and local landowners
  • Convenient to Inverin, Spiddal and the wider Connemara region
